create_JitScalarType_from_tensor: create a JitScalarType from a torch.Tensor by calling JitScalarType.from_value with the tensor
create_JitScalarType_from_dtype: create a JitScalarType from a torch.dtype by calling JitScalarType.from_dtype with the dtype
convert_JitScalarType_to_onnx: convert a JitScalarType to an ONNX TensorProtoDataType by calling onnx_type
test_valid_scalar_name: test whether a given scalar name is a valid JIT scalar type name using valid_scalar_name
test_valid_torch_name: test whether a given torch name is a valid torch type name using valid_torch_name
